system.longDesc:
An AI expert system that can walk a user through essential medical treatments, effectively providing a +1 bonus to Intelligence (Medicine) tests and allowing characters lacking the focus to still make tests, so long as they can follow the auto-doc’s written and audio instructions. More advanced auto-docs (+2 to Resources cost) are installed in robotic surgical suites and can perform routine surgeries and other medical treatments with a TN of 11 or less automatically. This includes automatically stabilizing a dying patient if that is possible.

Resources TN 14.
